Title: Enacts the Public Health Modernization Act
Summary: Directs the department to repeal subpart 24-2 of part 24 of title 10 of the New York Codes, Rules and Regulations in its entirety and promulgate new rules and regulations governing the licensing and operation of certain commercial establishments.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to enacting the "Public Health Modernization Act"
